component.title: Button
component.purpose: Provide a token-bound action control whose accessible name, disabled state, and variant intent survive reuse across scenario UIs.

priorities.statement: The button communicates one clear action through its accessible name in every example state.
Disabled and destructive states remain perceivable without changing the component contract.
Icon-bearing buttons keep text available so the visual glyph is never the only label.

states.description: Primary call-to-action example with the label Save changes.
Danger variant example for irreversible actions.
Disabled secondary action with a long label.
Icon-leading action that still exposes text.

claims.statement: The primary example renders a named button action.
The destructive example renders a named button action.
The disabled long-label example still renders a named button action.
The icon-leading example exposes text through the same button action.
A leading icon and its action label maintain a visible inline separation.
The disabled example prevents activation while retaining its visible action label.
